about: The priest addresses Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God. He recalls the work of salvation accomplished through Christ’s death, by the will of the Father and with the cooperation of the Holy Spirit. He asks to be delivered from iniquity and evil, to remain faithful to the commandments, and never to be separated from Christ.

seg.tr: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God,
who, by the will of the Father and with the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, brought the world to life through Your death:
deliver me through this Your most holy Body and Blood from all my iniquities and from all evils:
and make me always hold fast to Your commandments, and never permit me to be separated from You:
who, being God, live and reign with the same God the Father and with the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen.
